description: How a surface takes light: Blinn-Phong (gl), or physically based (gfx: its specular and shininess as roughness and metalness, unless they're given), with what it gives off itself.

color.description: Its own colour (a panel's: what's drawn on it) (#rrggbb).

texture.description: An image in the theme's textures/ it's covered with.

normal_texture.description: A normal map (OpenGL's, +y up) in the theme's textures/ (gfx).

orm_texture.description: An image in the theme's textures/ holding occlusion (red), roughness (green) and metalness (blue) (gfx).

repeat.description: How many times its textures repeat across each face, across and down (2 numbers): 1 and 1, left out (gfx).

specular.description: How much of a light's shine it gives back, 0 to 1.

shininess.description: How sharp the shine is (8 dull, 128 glassy).

emissive.description: Light it gives off itself, whatever lights it (on a panel or a texture: its picture, lit by it) (#rrggbb).

glow.description: How much brighter than its colour what it gives off is, for bloom: 1 for none.

shader.description: A desktop shader of the theme's (ThemeSceneCode's shaders) drawn in place of this lighting there; every other app draws the rest of this material.
